journey.name: Per-Country Payment Gateway Control
journey.description: Validates that an administrator can view all payment gateways configured for a country (Nigeria), enable or disable individual gateways with impact confirmation, choose the country default gateway, and save the settings.

story.title: Store impact count before gateway disable

actions.action: Sign in to the Admin Dashboard and navigate to '/dashboard/payment-gateways'.
Verify the page title reads 'Payment Gateway Management' and the 'Country Routing & Audit Trail' tab is active by default.
Verify the country selector shows 'Nigeria (NG)' selected and displays cards for Paystack, Korapay, Monnify, Flutterwave, Squad, and Nomba.
Verify each gateway card displays its name, supported payment methods, an enabled toggle switch, the number of stores currently using it, and a 'Make Default' or 'Active Default' button.
Verify Paystack is marked with the 'Default' badge and 'Active Default' indicator.
Click the toggle switch on an enabled gateway (e.g. Korapay) to disable it.
Verify a confirmation modal appears with title 'Disable Payment Gateway?' explaining the store impact count and stating that new checkouts will failover to other enabled gateways.
Click 'Confirm & Disable' in the modal and verify the toggle switch updates to disabled state.
Click 'Make Default' on Monnify and verify Monnify becomes the active default gateway.
Click 'Save NG Settings' and verify a success toast confirms the settings were saved.
